Conversation, family & daily routines

what time is it? phrase

also what’s the time?, o’clock

classical

Traupman 81, 89
M-O s.v. time: what time is it?
Hor. S. 2.6.44 hōra quota est?

Quota hōra est?

Examples

  • Est prīma ferē hōra.

    It’s about one o’clockTraupman 81

  • Quota hōra est, tata? — Septima ferē.

    What time is it, Dad? — About seven.composed

Other words

  • Quot hōrae sunt?

    also used · classical · Traupman 89

See also at what time?, ask the time, hour, check the time.

SourcesLewis & Short: quotus

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 81, 89.

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. time: what time is it?.
